scope: Desk synthesis and reproducible conditional models across nine work packages. No new excavation, specimen analysis, DFT run, certified building design, supplier quote or lifecycle product assessment.

components.label: Internal voids and passages

components.geometry: Component quantity unmeasured in this increment; geometric envelope is a separate calculation.

components.label: Perth 180 m² dwelling anchor

constraints: Maintain equivalent required performance and a declared 50-year comparison life.
Authored costs and emissions are scenarios, not quotes, certified performance or verified abatement.

histories.label: Quarried bodies with mechanical working
histories.summary: Baseline chain; individual shaping and placement methods still need component-specific records.
sequence: Identify and extract source rock
Rough-shape and finish using specified percussion or abrasive operations
Transport with a declared route and payload
Place, joint and finish
Track exposure and subsequent intervention
predictions: Extraction waste and tool/abrasive traces appropriate to the operation
Transport and site infrastructure consistent with demand
qualifications: Feasible mechanical action does not identify the exact ancient tool or rate.
Documentary transport evidence does not resolve every shaping or placement detail.

histories.label: Quarried bodies with chemical assistance

Accepted removal improvement over matched heat/flow/mechanical controls
Reagent, energy and waste inventory compatible with the process
qualifications: Modern hydrothermal evidence has a different regime from proposed ancient use.
